claims.claim: AUTHOR_TASK implements handoff-free new and revised TASK mutation through direct final-contract validation and canonical/provenance guards, with audit composition, validation, ledger checks and freshness reconstruction removed.
AUTHOR_TASK rejects supplied audited_handoff material at carrier parsing and native ingress, including during replay.
Direct TASK schema, identity/revision, verification-policy, affinity, expected-main, unrelated-delta and compare-and-swap safeguards remain intact.
Independent origin-proof admission, exact carrier/envelope bindings, HMAC, freshness, replay protections and legacy/revision separation remain unchanged.
REMEDIATION and REPAIR retain audited-handoff enforcement, canonical reconstruction, correction-lineage validation and freshness barriers.
All three normative documents state the direct AUTHOR_TASK rule, mark historical H1/H3 TASK gates superseded and preserve two-stage Brain semantic audit and correction requirements.
Focused regression tests cover direct TASK success, handoff rejection, preserved safety/provenance failures and correction audited-handoff enforcement.
